objective: Make the first real DSH goal round run survivable and reviewable in agent-relay: recover a ledger whose last round was cut off, detect a plan that drifted from what rounds were approved against, and assemble a per-round evidence bundle. Offline source, tests and docs only.

tasks.title: crash-safe ledger tail: report an unfinished round instead of skipping it
tasks.acceptance: recoverTail(text) returns {records, torn} and drops a partial final line without throwing; openRounds(records) lists rounds whose outcome is missing or still continue-for-the-same-task; node test_t095b159_round_evidence.mjs green and every other test_*.mjs still green

tasks.title: plan drift detection between the approved plan file and the recorded rounds
tasks.acceptance: planDigestOf(plan) equals the digest goal_plan.mjs prints; verifyPlanBinding reports plan_drift when a record's planDigest differs from the file on disk and ok when they match; both paths covered by a test

tasks.title: per-round evidence bundle an operator can read after a background run
tasks.acceptance: buildEvidence({plan, records, commit, gates}) emits one entry per round with taskId, outcome, gate results, recordDigest and the commit sha, plus a markdown renderer; GOAL_RUNBOOK.md documents the bundle; release_gate --clean-clone passes
